entry.title: Yale Engineering Dean's Invited Speaker Series featuring Jaime Teevan, Chief Scientist, Microsoft

media:group.media:title: Yale Engineering Dean's Invited Speaker Series featuring Jaime Teevan, Chief Scientist, Microsoft
media:group.media:description:
We've recently lived through what has felt like a series of disruptive shifts: cloud, remote work, and now AI. But these aren't isolated moments; they're chapters in a single story about how technology reshapes collaboration. Today, most AI systems are optimized for individuals, yet the most meaningful work we do is shared, messy, and collaborative.
Jaime Teevan '98 (computer science), Chief Scientist and Technical Fellow at Microsoft, explores how AI can evolve to support that reality through AI native processes, new knowledge artifacts, and socially intelligent models designed for group work. The future of work isn't about using AI to produce more on our own. To unlock the true potential of AI, we must use it to help teams and organizations work better together.
#Ai #microsoft #womenleaders #computerscience

entry.title: Yale Engineering Dean's Invited Speaker Series featuring Gus Fuldner, Senior VP, Core Services, Uber

media:group.media:title: Yale Engineering Dean's Invited Speaker Series featuring Gus Fuldner, Senior VP, Core Services, Uber
media:group.media:description:
Gus Fuldner is the Senior Vice President of Safety & Core Services, leading the team that brings together critical cross-company functions, including safety, customer support, payments, insurance, and scaled tech solutions. Prior to this role, he served as the Vice President of Safety & Insurance. Since Gus joined Uber in 2013, he has overseen the early development of insurance for the rideshare industry and Uber’s groundbreaking US Safety Report.
Gus shared fascinating insights into how Uber applies AI at a global scale — from machine learning powering core operations, to physical AI enabling efficient mobility, to the emerging potential of generative AI across customer support.
His talk highlighted not only the technical depth behind Uber’s systems but also the human and societal impact of deploying AI responsibly and safely.
#uber #ubereats #agenticai #responsibleai #machinelearning #ai

entry.title: Yale Engineering Dean's Invited Speaker Series featuring Greg Peters, co-CEO, Netflix

media:group.media:title: Yale Engineering Dean's Invited Speaker Series featuring Greg Peters, co-CEO, Netflix
media:group.media:description:
Greg Peters is the co-CEO of Netflix. Previously, he served as Chief Operating Officer and Chief Product Officer. Earlier, Greg was International Development Officer for Netflix. Prior to joining Netflix in 2008, he was Senior Vice President of consumer electronics products for Macrovision Solutions Corp. (later renamed to Rovi Corporation) and previously held positions at digital entertainment software provider, Mediabolic Inc., Red Hat Network, the provider of Linux and Open Source technology, and online vendor Wine.com. Greg holds a B.S. in physics and astronomy from Yale.
Greg sat down with Dean Jeffrey Brock for an inspiring conversation about his career journey, the exponential growth of Netflix, and how the company continues to innovate and determine what’s next in the ever-evolving world of entertainment and technology.
It was a fascinating discussion that highlighted the power of curiosity, adaptability, and innovation—core values that resonate deeply with our engineering community.
#leadership #innovation #netflix #technology #careerjourney

entry.title: Yale Engineering Dean’s Invited Speaker Series featuring Wen Chen, CTO, AP Memory

media:group.media:title: Yale Engineering Dean’s Invited Speaker Series featuring Wen Chen, CTO, AP Memory
media:group.media:description:
While AI High Performance Computing has pushed the entire semiconductor industry to the forefront of international politics, two fundamental challenges remain: memory bandwidth (or information bandwidth) and power delivery (or energy bandwidth). AI computing, by its model-based nature, is memory bandwidth limited. Memory bandwidth is rooted in hardware architecture. Current mainstream hardware architecture is approaching its memory bandwidth ceiling. In the meantime, delivering thousands of watts at sub-1-volt voltage means sending thousands of amperes without dropping even 0.1 volt.
Wen Chen ’92 PhD, co-founder, CEO, and CTO of AP Memory discusses how the semiconductor industry is experiencing a power delivery challenge which presents a cap on computing performance.
#efficientai #memory #semiconductors #yaleengineering #memorysolutions

entry.title: Yale Engineering Dean’s Invited Speaker Series featuring Mukesh Khare, GM and VP, IBM

media:group.media:title: Yale Engineering Dean’s Invited Speaker Series featuring Mukesh Khare, GM and VP, IBM
media:group.media:description:
The semiconductor industry is projected to reach $1T globally by 2030. The development of a robust and sustainable semiconductor research and development (R&D) ecosystem is vital as the U.S. and the world move towards self-reliance in semiconductors. The increasing demands on compute for generative AI and quantum are driving significant opportunity for semiconductor innovation. Private-public partnerships are key to accelerate the transition of technology breakthroughs from R&D into manufacturing.
Mukesh Khare '99 PhD, General Manager, Semiconductors and Vice President, Hybrid Cloud Research at IBM highlights IBM's innovation and ecosystem development for advanced semiconductors that are needed to secure our future in this exciting new chapter of generative AI and quantum.
#IBM, #Semiconductors, #GenerativeAI, #Quantum, #Innovation

entry.title: Dean’s Fireside Chat with André Hoffmann, Vice-Chairman of Roche

media:group.media:title: Dean’s Fireside Chat with André Hoffmann, Vice-Chairman of Roche
media:group.media:description:
André Hoffmann is the vice-chairman of the global healthcare company, Roche, a Swiss business leader, and environmentalist. He believes in business as a force for good, and advocates for a form of capitalism aimed at generating sustainable and inclusive prosperity. Author of The New Nature of Business: The Path to Prosperity and Sustainability, he presents a template for creating "sustainable prosperity," and case-studies of companies that survived and thrived by opting for change. André joins Dean Jeff Brock for a fireside chat to discuss his new book, Roche's approach to business, and how to reinvent business models to create sustainable prosperity.
#sustainability #newnatureofbusiness #globalhealthcare #environment #business #nature
